channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: U.S. and Iran pause fighting to give peace talks 'space.' Here's where negotiations stand
item.description: A temporary pause to the U.S.-Iran conflict appeared to hold on Monday, after negotiations over a lasting peace faced fresh hurdles over the weekend.

item.title: Ford wants more customers to customize vehicles to boost profits as it eyes 'Nike shoe drop' moments
item.description: Ford is expanding its accessory and parts business in an effort to boost profits and better tap into the $53 billion U.S. automotive aftermarket industry.

item.title: Nvidia, SpaceX, Microsoft launch AI safety initiative as OpenAI cyberattack fallout continues
item.description: Microsoft, SpaceX, Palantir, alongside dozens of other tech companies from the U.S. and Europe, have joined the Open Secure AI Alliance.

item.title: Why Trump's new tariff blitz is very different this time around
item.description: President Trump on Friday launched a fresh round of tariffs targeting 60 trading partners, including the European Union, China, and the U.K.

item.title: Rivian will emerge as big winner as robotaxi market grows, says Piper Sandler
item.description: The electric vehicle manufacturer is set to be a key player in future markets thanks to vertical integration, the investment firm said.

item.title: Apple options are doing something unusual into earnings
item.description: After going nowhere for seven months, Apple stock is up 20% since its late-June low and less than two dollars below a fresh all-time record.

item.title: Chipmaker CXMT’s 466% market debut surge makes it the most valuable China-listed company
item.description: The Hefei-based company raised 57.92 billion yuan ($8.6 billion) after pricing its IPO at 8.66 yuan per share.

item.title: New UK Prime Minister Burnham says he would be prepared to call out Trump
item.description: Burnham said he had a phone conversation with Trump on Monday when he officially took on the role, describing it as "a good exchange".

item.title: Finland’s radical answer to renewable energy’s biggest headache: The world’s largest sand battery
item.description: A small Finnish town has turned to the world's largest commercial sand battery to tackle a major hurdle in the energy transition: intermittency.

item.title: Ukraine strikes Iranian vessels in Caspian Sea, Tehran accuses Kyiv of 'hostile and criminal act'
item.description: The latest attacks by Ukraine, combined with Saudi military strikes on Iran-backed Houthi targets in Yemen, represent a widening of the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Spain and France wildfires force more than 300,000 to flee as Macron calls crisis meeting
item.description: The impact of a gigantic wildfire ravaging France's Bordeaux region and Spain has been like a "clap of thunder" for the local economy, a minister said.

item.title: Europe wildfire in pictures: Gigantic fire cloud engulfing France, Spain regions
item.description: A rare wildfire spreading across France's Bordeaux region and has spread to Western Madrid is fire cloud that can generate its own thunderstorms.

item.title: Ford and General Motors get upgraded by Jefferies, which sees sharp gains ahead
item.description: The bank upgraded both automakers to buy from hold.

item.title: Some high-earning investors will soon owe taxes on years of deferred capital gains
item.description: A key incentive in place for current Opportunity Zone investors — deferring taxation of reinvested capital gains — will end on Dec. 31.

item.title: Three killed, four wounded in Seattle food festival shooting, police say
item.description: Three people were killed and four others, including a toddler, were wounded on Sunday in a shooting at a downtown Seattle food festival, police said.

item.title: Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
item.description: Nvidia is aggressively securing supply of high-bandwidth memory, an essential component for its GPUs and systems.

item.title: From Silicon Valley to DC, the tech world is suddenly obsessed with one concept in AI: Distillation
item.description: Distillation has long been a topic for AI wonks, but it's become a hot-button issue of late as techies and lawmakers debate how it should be regulated.

item.title: Imax 70 mm screenings become the biggest star for Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’
item.description: Moviegoers are traveling, lining up and paying premiums to see Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ in scarce Imax 70 mm screenings.

item.title: Cocoa prices are easing. So why is chocolate still so expensive?
item.description: Chocolate firms look to win shoppers back with premium products and social media trends after poor weather conditions, tariffs, and the Iran war hit sales.

item.title: Here's the tech stock to buy in a market losing patience with tech
item.description: It's not the spend, it's the return.

item.title: Analysis: A powerful new coalition of AI skeptics is coalescing right in Trump's blind spot
item.description: Evangelicals, labor unions and anti-AI-data-center activists are part of a groundswell worrying about how fast technology is changing.

item.title: When to claim Social Security — and how to build the rest of your retirement income
item.description: You can start collecting Social Security benefits at age 62, but there's a real upside to waiting.

item.title: How AI wealth could be distributed to all Americans
item.description: AI riches are already concentrated among a handful of powerful companies, but there are plenty of new, some radical, ideas about how to spread the wealth.

item.title: Logistics giants are racing to keep up with healthcare boom as GLP-1s highlight need for cold storage
item.description: Shipping and logistics companies are tapping into the growing market of healthcare as cold chain and temperature-controlled facilities become more crucial.

item.title: 100 days until midterm election: DCCC Chair DelBene says Democrats have the momentum
item.description: Democrats see a path back to the U.S. House majority this November as President Donald Trump's approval dips.

item.title: Buffett favors an estate tax, but like virtually all billionaires, he won't be paying it
item.description: Warren Buffett believes he and other very wealthy Americans are under-taxed but by giving his fortune to charity, he won't be paying billions in potential levies to the government.

item.title: Singapore tightens monetary policy in surprise move as rising oil prices rekindle inflation risk
item.description: Unlike most central banks, the MAS manages medium-term price stability by managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of currencies.

item.title: For Gen X investors, dotcom bubble haunts stock market portfolios closing in on retirement
item.description: Many Americans in the 50-55 age range have 10 to 15 work years left, extending 401(k), IRA growth investing, but they can't afford an ill-timed market crash.

item.title: China industrial profit growth slows again in June as retreating oil prices sap earnings lift
item.description: Corporate earnings have staged one of the strongest turnarounds in the economy this year, swinging from barely positive growth in 2025 to double-digit gains.

item.title: Indonesia central bank governor Perry Warjiyo steps down in surprise move
item.description: Indonesia's central bank governor, Perry Warjiyo, resigned on Mon. in a surprise move, raising investor fears over central bank independence and fiscal policy.
